title: 秋華賞の後に・変わったのは

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text: What a great race! That's another Triple Tiara for the books.

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text: Harp Alpha held her own, and Yukino Bijin was incredible!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text: Still, it's a bit of a bummer that the crowd wasn't as hyped up as at the Japanese Oaks. The atmosphere's been incredible up until now.

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text: Guess this is what happens when a trend dies down… Anyway, let's get going.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yukino…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So you're feeling it now too…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ngh…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Someth'n's off.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (I finished the race, and I did good too! But…)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: There was noth'n dazzl'n about my runn'n…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: My mind was doing somersaults, so my performance was noth'n like it was at the Queen Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (I know people are still cheer'n me on, but…)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's just… diff'rent from b'fore.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I guess simply winn'n just isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanted t'become the city girl ev'ryone wants t'cheer for, but…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Turns out that's not the me that ev'ryone else wants t'see.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Maybe if I wasn't determined t'win… if I was just some easygoing Snow Angel from the country…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Maybe then ev'ryone'd still like me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Sorry. I'm being a real party pooper, aren't I? We should be decid'n my next race.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But…
choice_data_list: Let's treat ourselves to a nice dinner.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sorry…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the adult here, there are a number of ways I could go about trying to comfort Yukino Bijin, but I'm not the person she really needs right now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh no! Mifuyu's already split!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, at least I got t'talk to her a bit. She's been cheer'n me up as long as I can remember.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's her friend that she needs. Those two have always lifted each other up and pushed the other forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I could say anything in the world to her, but her friend would do infinitely more to reach her heart.
